name: Ble Kedros REIC
summary: Ble Kedros REIC is a real estate investment firm specializing in Real Estate. It operates in the fields of property investment, development, and management. The firm primarily invests in commercial real estate assets that can be utilized immediately, including stores, offices, and industrial buildings, as well as assets for future development such as plots of land. It also targets hospitality properties through either the acquisition of established assets or the renovation and development of existing buildings. The firm seeks long-term leases of its assets with reliable tenants. Ble Kedros REIC was founded in 2014 and is based in Kifissia, Greece.
